title: GitRaven
tagline: Introducing GitRaven! (get revenue) An opensource web3 & DeFi platform to support developers who contribute to opensource projects.
description: Git Raven is a platform where maintainers can list opensource projects to make their project active. Developers who contribute can earn various cryptocurrencies on different networks and collectibles either through tippings or from bounties set by the repo maintainer or sponsor.
how_its_made:
Webapp : NextJS, TailwindCSS, DaisyUI
Tableand : Data storage in SQL tables
 
We have deployed a smart contract that keeps track on bounties and their submissions, people list bounties and contributors solve those bounties in exchange for some reward.
We are storing data on three different tableland tables from the contract and reading those values from our frontend.
